description: Defines enums, structs, and function prototypes for a simple inter-process communication (IPC) API, including client and server side functionalities, connection options, and server management routines.

methods.name: ipc_get_active_state
methods.description: Determines if a server is listening on a given named pipe or socket.

methods.name: ipc_client_try_connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the IPC server and returns the connection state.

methods.name: ipc_client_close_connection
methods.description: Closes an active IPC client connection.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command_to_connection
methods.description: Sends a message to the server over an existing connection and receives a response.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command
methods.description: Connects to the server at a given path, sends a message, and receives a response.

methods.name: ipc_server_init_async
methods.description: Initializes an asynchronous IPC server instance with specified options and callback.

methods.name: ipc_server_stop_async
methods.description: Signals the IPC server to stop accepting new connections and finish existing ones.

methods.name: ipc_server_await
methods.description: Blocks until all server threads have completed.

methods.name: ipc_server_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the IPC server.

methods.name: ipc_server_run
methods.description: Runs a synchronous IPC server, blocking until shutdown or error.
